why_it_moved.label: measured
why_it_moved.text: Successful Search Rate did not move (-0.10%, -0.40% to +0.20%), and it was just as flat in the last days as in the first, so this is not a novelty effect.

why_it_moved.label: inferred
why_it_moved.text: Zero Result Rate fell 12.00% and CTR fell 1.80%. The likely link is that queries that used to return nothing now return weak results, which pulls the CTR average down without helping success.

why_it_moved.label: guess
why_it_moved.text: Nothing else on the scorecard moved beyond what chance would produce, so no other story is needed.

would_change: A cut on queries that had zero results in control showing a clear success gain would mean the ranker helps hard queries and the flat total hides it.
A pre-exposure comparison of Successful Search Rate showing no gap between arms would close the one check that could not run.
